spellbook.finance/limitations: workspaceId validates caller ownership only. eBay shipping policies belong to the connected eBay account and can affect eligible listings across all of the caller's workspaces.
Account-level readback does not prove what a buyer sees at checkout. Verify an eligible listing through eBay checkout separately.
missingFields and limitations identify settings or provider evidence that this route could not verify.

description: Read the caller's connected eBay shipping charges and provider readback. workspaceId proves the caller owns a SpellBook workspace; eBay settings remain scoped to that caller's connected eBay account. Read this before changing shipping charges.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.
